name: Numerical Gradient Eikonal Loss
aliases: Numerical Gradients for Surface Normal Computation
definition: A method to compute surface normals for SDFs using numerical gradients to overcome the locality of analytical gradients in hash encoding, allowing back-propagation updates to propagate to non-local hash grid cells.
summary: Numerical Gradient Eikonal Loss is a regularization technique that enforces the eikonal equation via numerical finite differences to distribute optimization updates beyond local hash grid cells, ensuring non-local smoothness.
